subject: FintechCo — deployment requirements & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: FintechCo — deployment requirements & next steps

Hi Alex — great call earlier, thanks for the time. Recap below and suggested next steps so we can align with your security and procurement teams.

Call recap (high level)
- Primary use case: real-time fraud scoring and customer support augmentation (low single-digit token latency SLO)
- Expected peak qps: ~60 rps (batched inferencing for bulk scoring) + spikes to 200 rps
- Key integration constraints: SSO via Okta (SAML), customer-managed key requirement (BYOK/HSM for signing of sensitive artifacts), and long-term logging/retention + SIEM ingestion (7+ years retention asked by security)
- Compliance: FintechCo requires FedRAMP-like controls for certain workloads; SOC 2 report requested

Initial thoughts on deployment mode (from Redwood)
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding, but limited options for customer-managed KMS/HSM and logging retention — standard hosted logs retention is 30 days unless we layer export/archival (not recommended for PHI/PII-sensitive retention policies)
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools in your cloud/region — supports customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest and can extend logging retention via log export hooks to your SIEM; good middle ground for predictability and some data isolation
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full customer control for key hierarchies (HSM integrations), custom logging retention policies, and private network requirements — recommended if FintechCo requires FIPS-level HSM or air-gapped operations

Requested items / next steps
1) Can you confirm whether the KMS requirement is strictly an HSM (FIPS 140-2/3) or if cloud KMS (customer-managed keys in AWS/GCP/Azure) satisfies the policy?
2) Can security share the specific logging retention policy (timelines + who will retain/ingest logs)?
3) Procurement: do you have a preferred contract template / PO workflow?
4) We'll prep a short technical note that maps the tradeoffs and recommended POC path (Dedicated POC vs Private engagement).

I'll have Connor draft the technical note and sizing workbook and share the SOC 2 PDF. Proposed times for an architecture workshop: next Tue/Wed morning PT — does that work for you and your security lead?

Thanks — 
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifying points from our side:

- KMS/HSM: our security team prefers hardware-backed key storage for production models that sign tokens and handle customer PII. If cloud KMS (e.g., AWS KMS with customer managed keys) meets the HSM requirement, we can accept Dedicated, otherwise we'd need Private. Security will confirm but wanted to flag that as a possible gating item.
- Logging: security requires logs to be forwarded to our SIEM and retained for 7 years for audit purposes. We need assurance that either Dedicated or Private can reliably support this without redaction of audit trails.
- SSO: Okta SAML is standard for us (all employees). Also we need SCIM for provisioning.

Procurement note: procurement@fintechco.com included — we prefer a one-year committed pricing for Dedicated if that ends up being the path. For Private, we'll need an estimate for one-time deployment and annual support.

Can Connor/your team confirm the technical feasibility and any gotchas for: BYOK/HSM, SCIM provisioning with our IdP, and long-term log export? Also please include rough cost buckets so procurement can triage.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Platform Engineering | FintechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: FintechCo — deployment requirements & next steps

Alex — thanks, looping in the technical details below. I'm also attaching a short architecture sketch and a sizing workbook to illustrate Dedicated vs Private cost/infra differences.

Quick answers up front:
- BYOK/HSM: Dedicated supports customer-managed keys via cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) with CMKs; these are not HSM appliances in-customer-control but are backed by provider HSMs. If FintechCo policy explicitly requires a customer-controlled HSM (FIPS 140-2/3 certified appliance under your control), that's a Private/on-prem requirement where we integrate with your HSM or deploy a Redwood-private control plane that can talk to an on-prem HSM.
- SCIM / SSO: We support SAML 2.0 (Okta) and SCIM provisioning. For Dedicated, SCIM is supported via your IdP to the instance — we can provide the endpoint and documentation. For Private, SCIM/SSO is configured inside your VPC and connects to your IdP directly.
- Logging retention / SIEM: Hosted retains logs 30 days by default and supports export via secure sinks. Dedicated can push logs to your SIEM via secure forwarding and we can configure retention/export rules; typically procurement adds an observability retention addon. Private gives you full control — logs can be ingested directly into your SIEM and retained per your policy (including 7+ years).

Gotchas / notes:
- If you need crypto operations to occur entirely within an HSM you control (no cloud KMS), that requires Private and lead time for HSM procurement / network setup (~6–10 weeks).
- Long-term log retention often runs into cost and egress considerations — we can provide a recommended pattern (daily export to encrypted object storage in your account, lifecycle policies, and SIEM ingestion).
- For Dedicated sizing, the biggest cost drivers will be peak concurrency and whether you need reserved burst capacity. I've attached an initial sizing estimate.

Attachments: redwood-private-architecture.pdf, redwood-dedicated-sizing.xlsx

Proposed next step: 60-minute architecture workshop with your security engineer + our infra lead. Suggested windows: Tue 21 Jul 08:30–10:30 PT or Wed 22 Jul 09:00–11:00 PT. If those don't work, propose alternatives.

Connor Obrien

Connor — thanks for the clear breakdown and the artifacts, that helps a lot. A few follow-ups from security:

- Security confirmed they want HSM-backed key storage for model signing and token signing in production. Cloud KMS with CMKs is not sufficient for the production path.
- For initial non-prod / staging we can accept Dedicated with CMK; production must be Private (HSM). That means we'll need pricing for both: Dedicated (1 year committed) and Private (one-time deploy + annual support).
- Logging: security will own the retention; they want an exported copy of raw request logs (no PII) for 7 years. Can you include a proposed export pipeline (obj storage + lifecycle + SIEM ingestion) in the architecture doc?

Procurement: please send a rough MSA/statement of work outline and the one-year committed price range for Dedicated so we can budget. If Private is the required production configuration, we need an estimated delivery timeline and ballpark costs for infra + Redwood services.

We can do the architecture workshop on Tue 21 Jul 09:00 PT — security will join. Please confirm and share a calendar invite.

— Alex
